$3,500 a month. That's what a receptionist costs by the time you count salary, taxes and the seat she sits in.

And she goes home at five. She takes lunch. She calls in sick. She can't answer two lines at once.

Meanwhile the call you missed at 2:40 on a Tuesday didn't leave a voicemail. They called the next name on the list.

Here's the part that stings: you already paid for that lead. The ad. The referral. The truck with your name on it. You paid to make the phone ring, and then nobody picked it up.

Signature Funnels texts them back in four seconds, answers what they asked, and puts them on your calendar — whether or not anybody's holding a phone.

From $129/mo. Installed in a week. Link in bio.

Two weeks. No phone, no laptop.

Would leads still get answered? Would follow-up still go out? Would anything still get booked?

Be honest. Most owners say "some of it."

Some of it is the problem — because the part that runs through you is the part that stops when you stop.

That isn't a work ethic problem. You work plenty. It's that nothing was ever built to work without you.
